findings.advice: One solve_native_mean call already constructs one model; invoke one write_native_mean for its returned success/partial cache. Do not prebuild, reconstruct from saved model, re-evaluate F/T, or retry under another initial guess. Cache writer result once and retain partial output if later summary work fails.

Use geometry native grid and explicit unchanged task/material/background/workpiece/path. Schema1.1 targets must exactly match task.path;1.0 default targets are[0,input.target]. Expose response_mode complete/mechanical, tangent full/chunk256 and initial_guess tangent/port_projection explicitly. API accepts explicit settings unchanged; cold defaults remain complete/full/tangent. Existing CLI minimum increment is targets[1]/16, not DisplacementSettings fixed .025/16 default; keep the CLI rule and record actual settings.

Returned controller status failed is an ordinary partial result to save once. Requested/target response is null when the declared path is not completed; last accepted and prefix peak remain separate actual observations. Zero accepted means both null. On cycles distinguish maximum loading stroke/Fy peak from final requested endpoint; reaching peak alone is not completion.

Record only observable call boundary(stage read_task/solve/write_result/build_response/post_save_time_check), exact exception class/message and existing .code/.details. solve boundary includes constructor/input/controller setup, so do not invent a finer stage from code or message. OSError/ordinary ValueError without code stays null. Unexpected exceptions should not be converted into fabricated numerical partial states. Preserve genuine failure reasons; no automatic fallback or rerun.

Controller clock starts after its setup and excludes native construction and all saving. native_mean evaluation timing includes construction+solve but excludes writer. Existing CLI checks total STARTED timing after cache write and can fail after a success result exists. Keep controller/settings timing and whole entry+save+summary timing distinct. A total-time failure must be non-success with saved path retained, not overwritten solver status. Do not claim a hard process/RSS bound from a cooperative clock; finite external phase launcher remains separate.

Use native state R_input/q_out/minimum_J/max_abs_Hu_per_mm with their actual scopes; do not substitute qout for gap, global minimumJ/Hu for medium-only fields, or raster node_window_clearance for finite tip-segment distance. Green/finite gap plots are not in these state JSON scalars; absent observer-derived quantities/links stay null unless explicitly supplied same-result/same-state saved-view evidence. No body force means null, not zero.

Never change producer HF/equilibrium/HP flags. Parsing a summary cannot create reference or HF5 qualification. At most record an explicitly supplied existing reference witness and its reported scope after same result SHA/allN/state identities and actual2N count; absent/mismatched/unclosed witness is unqualified. No auto-discovery by case label or directory, no pressure/freebody/all-column/energy/strain-HP expansion. New forward output needs its own future reference stage.

R is actuator-on-model signed scalar; body forces are weak fixed lower-half on-body total/material/Hu components and holding is opposite.2absFy is mirror magnitude sum; full mirror net is(2Fx,0). Neither nodal force nor body sum is pressure or general contact qualification.

Use a new output directory, cheaply reject an already-existing output before expensive solve, and preserve existing writer no-overwrite behavior. Resolve explicit repo/input/output paths deterministically; do not read historical provenance as dependencies. A stdlib JSON response should pin saved result/task/source and optional view/reference files, not import HF or read NPZ. A summary/save failure preserves whatever actual result was written and does not trigger another solve or write.
